name: Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle
summary: High above Cragpool Lake, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle awaits a bounty in the Stonetalon Mountains. The rogue gnome overseer has replaced much of his decaying flesh with gears, clockwork machinery, and artificial limbs. Ziz Fizziks wants his mechanical arm as proof of his death, hoping it will win him a promotion.

sections.title: A Monstrous Hybrid
sections.body: Gerenzo’s body bears the marks of his transformations. Those who have seen him say his natural flesh is rotting beneath grafted gears, iron plating, and whirring clockwork limbs. He watches operations from near the great water wheel above Cragpool Lake, with no concern for his failing flesh.

sections.title: Goblin Ambitions
sections.body: Ziz Fizziks works for Sputtervalve and hopes Gerenzo’s fall will carry him out of Stonetalon. Ziz cannot climb the cliffs and defeat the augmented overseer himself, so he asks you to bring back Gerenzo’s mechanical arm. With it, he hopes to prove his worth and earn a transfer to the Tinkers’ Union workshops in Gadgetzan or Undermine.

sections.title: Clashing Philosophies
sections.body: Gerenzo’s mechanical arm reflects a sharp divide between gnome and goblin engineering. He cut away failing flesh to make room for complex prosthetics, a choice goblins find baffling. As Ziz sees it, goblin ingenuity would keep the natural limb and add an explosive third arm beside it.

faq.answer: In the Stonetalon Mountains, Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle is a renegade gnome overseer. He replaces parts of his decaying body with gears and mechanical limbs, and watches operations high above Cragpool Lake.

faq.q: Where can Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle be found?
faq.answer: Gerenzo is northeast of Ziz Fizziks, high above Cragpool Lake near a large industrial water wheel.

faq.q: Why does Ziz Fizziks want Gerenzo dead?
faq.answer: Sputtervalve has ordered Ziz Fizziks to eliminate Gerenzo. Ziz hopes that proving his competence will earn him a transfer to a Tinkers’ Union workshop in Gadgetzan or Undermine.
Ziz wants Gerenzo’s mechanical arm as proof that the overseer is dead.
Gerenzo’s flesh was rotting, so he grafted gears, iron plates, and mechanical limbs onto his body to sustain and augment himself.
Sputtervalve is a goblin supervisor who oversees operations and directs underlings like Ziz Fizziks from elsewhere in Kalimdor.

angles.text: Gerenzo’s mechanical arm shows how far gnomish bionic engineering can go, in sharp contrast with goblin practical design.
As a gnome, Gerenzo takes eccentric and macabre measures to preserve his failing body with radical self-augmentation.
As a member of the Horde, you can help goblin contractors in Stonetalon secure resources and territory while disrupting dangerous rogue engineers in the crags.
